rubric: Blind human labels, frozen before any provider output. Needed means the task or its observed actions match the skill trigger, not that the agent loaded it. A mere mention of a skill without a matching task is insufficient. A stop-only or connectivity task needs no implementation/review skills. Label only unambiguous cases; source goals were read from the named session segments and compared with each SKILL.md description. Summaries omit paths, private conversation, and credentials. Strata are skill and task type (explicit trigger, ordinary work, stop-only); this is a purposive balanced sample, not a random prevalence estimate.
